### New Atmosphere of Hellhound

Hellhound has long been guarding the gaming underworld and is committed to deliver the most reliable gaming experience. Remain simple and sleek; it is never humble in showing its strength when the gamers calls for. The Hellhound of this generation features a second LED color – amethyst purple—to provide a different atmosphere in your PC build.

### The Power of Hellhound

To provide a better thermal solution, PowerColor Hellhound RX 7600 is equipped with a dual fan design (2x 100mm), a cooler with 3X6Φ nickel-plated heatpipes, and a smooth nickel-plated copper base that enhances heat dissipation. Besides, it adopts 6+2 phase VRM with DrMOS, high polymer solid capacitors and one 8-pin PCI-E connectors to deliver advanced gaming performance.

...

### GAME. STREAM. ADVANCE.

Experience unprecedented performance, visuals, and efficiency for gaming and streaming in 1080p with the AMD Radeon™ RX 7600 graphics card, powered by AMD RDNA™ 3 architecture. Immerse yourself in breathtaking visuals with the pinpoint color accuracy of AMD Radiance Display™ Engine and boost frame rates with AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution and AMD Radeon™ Super Resolution upscaling technologies. To unlock even more performance, combine AMD Radeon™ RX 7000 Series graphics card with a compatible AMD Ryzen™ processor to activate AMD smart technologies.

### BREAKTHROUGH PERFORMANCE

AMD Radeon™ RX 7600 graphics card set a new level of performance for gamers and streamers. Featuring unified AMD RDNA™ 3 compute units, and blazing fast clock speeds, to enable advanced high refresh rate gaming performance at 1080p.

### BREATHTAKING VISUALS

Discover new levels of fidelity and ultra-fast gameplay with High-Performance Rendering, a combination of compute-based AMD FidelityFX™ features and upscaling technologies, to deliver world-class visuals with remarkable performance. Further immerse yourself with the AMD Radiance Display™ Engine and DisplayPort™ 2.1 to experience up to 68 billion colors for video playback at up to 8K. Deliver enhanced visual quality to your audience when streaming and recording using the improved encoders, together with integrated AI and content adaptive machine learning technology to enable better looking and crisper visuals when streaming.

...

### The Hellhound Gaming Experience

The Hellhound continues to be a steadfast guardian in the gaming world, dedicated to providing a dependable gaming experience. Its design is elegantly simple yet unapologetically powerful, ready to unleash its strength whenever gamers demand it. This generation's Hellhound adds a touch of versatility with a new LED color option – amethyst purple – offering an alternative ambiance for your PC setup.

### PowerColor HELLHOUND RX 7600 XT: Next-Level Performance

The PowerColor HELLHOUND Radeon™ RX 7600 XT is a testament to high-performance gaming, engineered with AMD's latest RDNA™3 architecture. This model is distinguished by its efficient cooling system, featuring a dual 100mm fan setup and four strategically placed nickel-plated heat pipes. Its power efficiency is further enhanced by a robust 7+2 phase VRM with SPS DrMOS and an 8+6 pin power connector, ensuring top-tier performance. The inclusion of high polymer solid capacitors and dual BIOS functionality underscores the HELLHOUND's commitment to both power and adaptability.

Ready yourself for today and tomorrow’s games with 16GB of GDDR6 memory and next-gen technologies. Experience incredible performance, visuals, and smoothness when gaming and streaming at 1080p and beyond with the AMD Radeon™ RX 7600 XT graphics card, powered by the AMD RDNA™ 3 architecture. Stay future-ready with AI accelerators, raytracing, AV1 hardware encoding, and support for the latest DisplayPort™ 2.1 technology.

### GAME

The AMD Radeon™ RX 7600 XT graphics card set a new level of performance for gamers. It features future-ready 16GB of GDDR6 memory, unified AMD RDNA™ 3 compute units, and next-generation technologies like AMD HYPR-RX, enabling ultra-fast and smooth gaming with ultra-detailed visuals for the best experience at 1080p, and the flexibility to jump up to 1440p. The Radeon™ RX 7600 XT graphics card delivers an incredible high refresh gaming & streaming experience, and the confidence to game for years to come.

Pcekspert - RX 7600 XT "RX 7600 XT 16 GB is a nice addition to the product series, but at the moment we don't see any significant developments for ordinary gamers who just want good performance in 1080p resolution - for them the RX 7600 8 GB cards will be quite enough. Finally, the price. MSRP is $329, while the RX 7600 starts at $269. That's a big difference in price for what it showed. However, as a future proof model, we can conditionally recommend the RX 7600 XT 16 GB. In any case, PowerColor did a very good job and this card is quiet and low consumption. If you are buying, the recommendation is to go for one of the OC models, or to overclock this one."

# PowerColor Unveils AMD Radeon™ RX 7600 Graphics Cards

Performance for every 1080p gamer

Taipei, Taiwan – May 25th , 2023 - TUL Corporation, a leading and innovative manufacturer of AMD graphic cards since 1997, announces today the launch of the PowerColor AMD Radeon™ RX 7600 HELLHOUND and PowerColor AMD Radeon RX 7600 FIGHTER series graphics cards. These cutting-edge graphic cards are engineered to cater to the needs of passionate gamers who demand exceptional reliability, performance, and quality.

### POWERCOLOR HELLHOUND AMD RADEON™ RX 7600 Graphics Card

| The shroud of the PowerColor HELLHOUND AMD Radeon™ RX 7600 graphics card is designed to be sleek and clean, with silver accents, resembling a calm and low-key hound that's always prepared to unleash its power. In addition to HELLHOUND’s symbolic ice blue lighting, a second color—amethyst purple—is added into LED color choices to provide user with more options to fit their PC color scheme. |
| --- |

| The card has a dual fan design (2x 100mm) and optimized 3X6Φ nickel-plated heat pipes that pass through the cooler heatsink, along with a smooth nickel-plated copper base. This combination provides an ideal solution for efficient thermal management, resulting in a cool and silent gaming experience. |
| --- |

| In addition to its highly efficient thermal management, the card incorporates a 6 2 phase VRM with DrMOS, high polymer solid capacitors, and an 8-pin PCI-E connector. This ensures both robust reliability and overclocking capabilities. The card also comes with dual-BIOS functionality. |

台灣台北 – 2023年5月25日 - 撼訊科技股份有限公司，自1997年以来一直是AMD图形卡的领先和创新制造商，今天宣布推出AMD Radeon™ RX 7600暗黑犬和FIGHTER系列图形卡。这些最先进的显卡是为了满足那些对1080p游戏体验要求极高的可靠性、性能和质量的热情游戏玩家的需求而设计的。

### 撼讯暗黑犬 AMD RADEON™ RX 7600 Graphics Card

| 撼讯暗黑犬 Radeon™ RX 7600是搭载在AMD最新的RDNA™3架构上的，它提供了更好的性能和效率。这使玩家能够轻松地征服1080p游戏。暗黑犬的护罩设计得圆滑而干净，以银色为基调，就像一只平静而低调的猎犬，随时准备释放出它的力量。它有两个100毫米的风扇，提供高效的冷却。除了暗黑犬系列的经典冰蓝配色，此次新增第二种迷幻紫灯效，为用户提供更多的选择，以适应他们的PC配色方案。 | |
| --- | --- |

| | 撼讯暗黑犬 Radeon™ RX 7600有一个双风扇设计（2x 100mm）和优化的3X6Φ镀镍热管，通过冷却器散热片，以及光滑的镀镍铜底座。这种组合为有效的热管理提供了一个理想的解决方案，从而带来了凉爽和安静的游戏体验。 |
| --- | --- |

| 除了高效的热管理外，该卡还采用了带有DrMOS的6+2相VRM、高聚合固体电容和8针PCI-E连接器。这确保了强大的可靠性和超频能力。该卡还配备了双BIOS功能。 | |
